## About
Thobeka Nkosi studied Life Sciences (Biochemistry and Physiology) and is a software engineering student at WeThinkCode_. Her projects cover Java, infrastructure, data, AI, and health technology.

## Portfolio
The site tells an interactive horizontal story on desktop, a vertical story on mobile, and includes projects, milestones and contact links. Based on Nidhi Prajapati's open-source MIT-licensed portfolio template: https://github.com/SomehowLiving/portfolio-template
